ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link a carry, Psychic Flare around both of you to blind enemies facing it, Energy Lance to stack slows into a root, and Hyperflux to give both of you attack speed, ability haste and speed.
ourKits.winCondition: Power up a linked carry with the Link and Hyperflux and keep them healthy with Essence Catalyst healing.
ourKits.passive: Essence Catalyst: abilities heal her and her linked ally over time, and her Phase Blink has a shorter cooldown and boosts her damage.
ourKits.playWith: The strongest carry to Link, ideally one who wants attack speed and ability haste.
ourKits.playAgainst: Turn away from Psychic Flare, since it only blinds enemies facing it, and break Energy Lance's beam before it reaches the root. Anti-heal cuts the shared healing; focus the linked carry or force the Link out of range.

ourKits.combo: Bramble Patch slow → Untamed Growth zone → Harvest Nettles stacks → Fly Trap pull and stun
ourKits.winCondition: land Fly Trap on several heroes and follow with zone damage
ourKits.passive: takedowns spawn an Untamed Growth and give her movement speed
ourKits.playWith: engage that holds enemies near her Fly Trap and Bramble Patch
ourKits.playAgainst: she has no dash, so dive her once Fly Trap is spent; stay out of Bramble Patch and Untamed Growth zones, and buy magical armor

ourKits.combo: Plasma Grenade slow → Air Assault to hover with extra range → Hypercharge burst → Atomiser to finish a low target
ourKits.winCondition: hover with Air Assault for extra basic range and shred with Hypercharge, refreshing it on takedowns
ourKits.passive: extra jump height; kills make the target explode, much larger from enemy heroes
ourKits.playWith: a frontline that holds enemies in place while she hovers and fires
ourKits.playAgainst: Air Assault is her only reposition, so engage after it ends and she is back on the ground; dodge Plasma Grenade's slow and sidestep the Atomiser channel, which stops on the first hero hit

ourKits.combo: Riplash to pull a hero in, Shock Therapy to break their shield and silence, Electrocute aura for damage and a shield, then Skewer to suppress everyone in front of him.
ourKits.winCondition: Land Riplash and chain silence and suppress so the target cannot fight back while their cooldowns stay frozen.
ourKits.passive: Suspended Sentence: while his abilities immobilize or silence a hero, their cooldowns stop ticking.
ourKits.playWith: Burst that deletes his pulled or suppressed target.
ourKits.playAgainst: Stay behind minions or spaced so Riplash cannot reach you, and fight while it is on cooldown. Tenacity shortens the chain, which also shortens the cooldown freeze.

ourKits.combo: Glacial Charge dashes in, Boreal Sweep slows, Hoarfrost roots enemies that touch the ring, then Cryoseism slows and stuns a target before it explodes
ourKits.winCondition: chain slow, root and stun to lock fights down while her Frost Storm grinds max-health damage
ourKits.passive: jumping mid-air leaps her and leaves a Replica that draws tower aggro; hitting a Hero or Monster 4 times summons a Frost Storm
ourKits.playWith: burst damage that turns her long CC chain into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: do not walk into the Hoarfrost ring while it persists; Cryoseism slows before it stuns, so cleanse or tenacity help, and spread so the explosion does not chain; she is weak once Glacial Charge is down

enemyKits.combo: Mortal Coil to pull enemies together and heal from them, Stupor from the air to Mesmerize, Soulfire waves for damage, then Abyssal Rift to teleport in and fire the singularity.
enemyKits.winCondition: Collect Essence to grow every ability, then zone fights with Mortal Coil and Abyssal Rift and execute low targets.
enemyKits.passive: Echoes of the Damned: nearby deaths can drop Essence (heroes always do) that she collects to empower her abilities, and she can hover after a mid-air jump.
enemyKits.playWith: A frontline that keeps enemies inside Mortal Coil and the singularity.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Watch for the 1.5s Abyssal Rift channel and leave the target area, and dodge the Stupor orb after she rises. Anti-heal cuts Mortal Coil healing; trade early before she stacks Essence.

enemyKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap in, Make Way to shred armor, Sacred Oath empowered cleave to slow, then Stone Forged Soul to heal in Stasis and crash down.
enemyKits.winCondition: Stay in the middle of fights and use Stone Forged Soul's missing-health heal to reset, while Make Way shreds armor for the team.
enemyKits.passive: Stoicism deflects the next basic attack on a cooldown and grants health regen and armor that grow as he loses health.
enemyKits.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow his leap and benefit from Make Way's armor shred.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Do not burst into Stone Forged Soul's Stasis; step away from the slow and the crash, then re-engage. Open with an ability since Stoicism deflects a basic, and buy anti-heal to cut the ult heal.

enemyKits.combo: Ambush leap and slow, Unleash for maximum attack speed cleaving basics, Cull to lock the target, Invigorate to cleanse and heal.
enemyKits.winCondition: Stick to one target, build Rage for regen and faster cooldowns, and out-sustain them in long fights.
enemyKits.passive: Ancestral Fury builds Rage on hits, giving health regen and faster cooldowns, plus movement speed at high Rage.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Buy anti-heal to cut Invigorate and Rage regen. Save your CC until after Invigorate is used since it cleanses, and break off for a few seconds so his Rage decays.

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush in unstoppable to knock back → Shield Bash stun → Shield Slam knockup and stun, Force Shield to block projectiles
enemyKits.winCondition: engage with Shield Slam or Bull Rush and protect carries with Force Shield's projectile wall
enemyKits.passive: a self-shield that lasts until broken and refreshes when out of damage, plus hybrid armor
enemyKits.playWith: ranged carries he can shield from enemy projectiles, and follow-up damage for his engages
enemyKits.playAgainst: Bull Rush is unstoppable, so do not waste CC into it; walk around Force Shield instead of shooting into it, and fight after Shield Slam is on cooldown

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses for attack speed → Hail of Arrows slow → Inner Fire barrage
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Relentless with basics and abilities to add max-health damage and melt the frontline in long fights
enemyKits.passive: Relentless stacks on hit and makes her basics deal bonus max-health damage
enemyKits.playWith: peel and a frontline, since her only escape is a short stealth
enemyKits.playAgainst: Heightened Senses is her only escape, a brief stealth with speed and no dash, so hard-engage her after it is used; Piercing Shot passes through terrain, so do not hide behind walls at low health

bullets: Overseer made Abyssal Rift deal 15% more damage and healed Renna for 25% of Rift damage to heroes, while Mortal Coil's Soul Orb also healed Renna.
Lotus gave a random bonus over time and each takedown; Early Bloom granted an extra level later on; Immaculate cut damage taken while near full health.
Stupor's area hit set off Entropy on several heroes; Caustica scaled with bonus magical armor on heroes above 50% health; Wraith Leggings boosted ability damage below 40% health.
With Feeding Frenzy's attack speed in fights, every basic attack set off Overlord's damage around the target and Mutilator's hit based on the target's max health.
Krix raised maximum health, so Stone Forged Soul restored more; Regenerative Tissue healed after a stretch without hero damage; Feeding Frenzy added attack speed per nearby enemy hero.
Taking magical damage set off Tainted Bastion, cutting the attacker's healing by 45% for 3s; Tainted Bastion also mitigated 3.5% of all damage taken, doubled against those attackers.
Untamed Growth and Bramble Patch hit areas: Megacosm's damage over time landed on several heroes, and Combustion, when off cooldown, hit the target and nearby enemies.
Vesh added damage over time to ability hits on heroes; Mind Rot added damage based on current health; The Tenth Seal boosted Fly Trap's damage and cooldown.

Weald fired true-damage missiles when Sparrow damaged a low-health hero, on a cooldown per hero; Forage added gold and experience per minion or monster kill.
